parts.headline: AI Spending Has Met Its First Real Bill
Habit Was the Moat. Agents Are Draining It.

mentions.excerpt: Apple, spending $14 billion this fiscal year, less than Amazon spends in a month, has chosen to be the anti-hyperscaler.
Within two weeks Muse was Apple’s most downloaded free app.

sides.question: who-collects
sides.claim: Muse is gaining traction: as of that Friday it ranked No. 1 in Apple's App Store ahead of ChatGPT at No. 2, Gemini at No. 8, and Claude at No. 13, and since its September 8 unveiling Meta has added nearly $170 billion in market cap and is up 9%…
